6Printer

Check your printer's bed size in its manual or slicer. Big frames split into more pieces on smaller beds. All the plates come in one 3MF that opens in Bambu Studio with every plate ready. Pick your own printer and settings there. Other slicers can use the STL files. Print the fit-test file first to check the corners click.
